QUOTE: The post is written locally before the network call, with its pending ID (`${currentUserId}:${timestamp}`) and no server ID yet, so it shows in the UI right away. ... If `client.createPost` throws, the post is kept with `props.failed = true`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is saved locally before sending and, on failure, kept with failed = true.
